scripts.dev: ([ -f .venv/bin/streamlit ] && .venv/bin/streamlit run app.py) || ([ -f ../.venv/bin/streamlit ] && ../.venv/bin/streamlit run app.py) || streamlit run app.py
scripts.test: ([ -f .venv/bin/python ] && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py") || ([ -f ../.venv/bin/python ] && ../.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py") || python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
